info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Contact Center Operations API
info.description: The Contact Center Operations API enables seamless access to channel-specific contact center data and operations. This API serves as a resource for retrieving comprehensive information regarding customer interactions, service requests, and performance metrics across different banking channels. Typical consumers include customer service agents and management systems looking to analyze and optimize customer support workflows. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their customer relationship management and improve operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve specific contact center operation details.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to access detailed information about a specific contact center operation identified by its unique resource ID. It provides essential data and insights related to the operation for effective management and analysis.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving channel-specific contact center operations. The expected JSON structure should align with the defined schema to ensure proper processing of the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested data.

GetContactCenterOperationByIdRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation in the contact center operations channel specific API. This request body is expected to be a string.

GetContactCenterOperationByIdResponse_20.title: Channel-specific Contact Center Operations Response

regionCode.description: Code indicating the geographical region of operation.

skillGroup.description: Identifier for the skill group assigned to handle operations.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the operational record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the record was last updated.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the operational response.
